Population.evidence_source: We interviewed 15 men (20–76 years old)... As regards methods used in their suicidal acts, 13 had taken an overdose of medication, one had swallowed a diluent, and one had tried to hang himself.

Area.evidence_source: five were currently going through, or had just been through a divorce... six were unemployed... Four lived alone... Only one of the men mentioned that he had some mental disorder diagnoses, namely anxiety and depression, and that he was on psychopharmacological medication... Two of the men revealed having been sexually abused from childhood... Alcohol was involved in five of the suicidal acts, whereas only two claimed to have problems with alcohol in general, and two others admitted taking drugs. Almost two thirds (n = 9) reported sleeping problems.
